charter_rows.activation_condition: Calendar event exists and is marked paid, and module is enabled.
charter_rows.creep_boundary: No background geofencing or all-day behavior outside explicit gig windows.
charter_rows.customer_visible_summary: This module checks location only during scheduled gig windows for check-in and mileage proof.
charter_rows.derived_proof_retention: Keep proof-ready location/time snippets for 18 months minimum.
desired_outcomes: Only check location during scheduled gig windows.
Capture arrival and mileage proof for finance and logistics evidence.
Surface missing-prep steps without exposing unrelated personal patterns.
charter_rows.developer_visible_summary: Gig automation is event-window-only and proof-gated.
charter_rows.observation_trigger: Calendar event start and finish for the active gig.
charter_rows.observation_window: Within each scheduled gig event window only.
charter_rows.operator_value: Keep the automation narrow to active gig work.
charter_rows.purpose: Track scheduled gigs, prep requirements, location proof, and invoice readiness.
charter_rows.raw_data_retention: No permanent raw GPS retention by default.

charter_rows.activation_condition: A workflow has an active gig reference and module is enabled.
charter_rows.creep_boundary: Only outfit tasks tied to a specific gig workflow id.
charter_rows.customer_visible_summary: This module can remind for wash/dry/hang steps and mark gig clothing as ready.
charter_rows.derived_proof_retention: Keep proof references for readiness and invoice traceability.
desired_outcomes: Two-day reminder before gigs.
Use integrated washer/dryer state for outfit prep.
Avoid tracking beyond gig prep tasks and workflow scopes.
charter_rows.developer_visible_summary: Outfit automation is scoped by workflow and approved integrations only.
charter_rows.observation_window: Two-day pre-gig prep lookback and active gig-prep session only.
charter_rows.operator_value: Reduce last-minute misses without turning laundry into profiling.
charter_rows.purpose: Prepare stage/gig clothing and keep outfit logistics bounded.
charter_rows.raw_data_retention: Keep only task states and state-change timestamps for 30 days.

charter_rows.activation_condition: Invoice workflow is active and module is enabled.

charter_rows.developer_visible_summary: No sent/paid mutation without explicit receipts.

charter_rows.purpose: Generate, send, and watch invoice states with explicit receipts.
charter_rows.raw_data_retention: Retain workflow proof for audit windows only.

charter_rows.creep_boundary: Only explicit thread IDs and owned thread members. No full mailbox scans.

Draft with guarded pre-send approvals.
Support outside-thread adoption offers without mailbox scans.
charter_rows.developer_visible_summary: Comms automation is limited to explicit ownership plus approvals.

charter_rows.activation_condition: Gig proof request inside an active event window.
charter_rows.creep_boundary: Only with explicit event window + purpose token. No ambient traces.

charter_rows.raw_data_retention: Raw GPS is opt-in and never retained without explicit proof-mode approval.
